# wisa_api test fixtures

These CSV files mirror what the WISA SOAP service emits as the
base64-decoded `Result` of a `GetCSVData` response. They drive the
connector's record-and-replay tests so the suite runs without a live
WISA host.

## Origin

The current fixtures are generated by
[`packages/wisa_api/tool/redact_fixtures.dart`](../../tool/redact_fixtures.dart)
from a real production export of the legacy WPF app's cached state.
That export lives under `artifacts/` in the repo root and is
**gitignored** — it contains real PII (names, national IDs, addresses)
and must never be committed. The redaction script:

- Keeps non-PII fields verbatim (class names like `1B1`, `2A`, `3OL`,
  admin/institute codes, dates, gender, WisaID, StemID, nationality
  category, group structures).
- Replaces every PII field with deterministic synthetic stand-ins
  (`Anon0001`, `Anon0001 Bis`, `Anon0025-X`, etc.) that preserve
  shape-driving edge cases like multi-word surnames and hyphenation.
- Pads `RIJKSREGISTERNR` to `00000000000`.
- Replaces `GEBOORTEPLAATS`, `STRAAT`, `POSTCODE`, `WOONPLAATS` with
  synthetic equivalents.
- Strips non-ASCII characters via Latin-1 → ASCII folding so the
  fixtures are encoding-safe.

To regenerate after refreshing `artifacts/`:

```
dart run packages/wisa_api/tool/redact_fixtures.dart
```

## File-to-query mapping

| File                  | Query        | Header                                                                                                          |
| --------------------- | ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `sma_get_inst.csv`    | `SMAGetInst` | `ID,NAME,DESCRIPTION` (note: legacy swaps NAME and DESCRIPTION on the model)                                    |
| `sma_sync_lln.csv`    | `SmaSyncLln` | `KLAS,KLASGROEP,NAAM,VOORNAAM,ROEPNAAM,GEBOORTEDATUM,WISAID,STAMBOEKNUMMER,GESLACHT,RIJKSREGISTERNR,GEBOORTEPLAATS,NATIONALITEIT,STRAAT,STRAATNR,BUSNR,POSTCODE,WOONPLAATS,KLASWIJZIGING` |
| `sma_sync_per.csv`    | `SmaSyncPer` | `CODE,WISAID,FAMILIENAAM,VOORNAAM`                                                                              |
| `sync_klas.csv`       | `SyncKlas`   | `KLAS,KLASGROEP,OMSCHRIJVING,ADMINGROEP,INSTELLINGSNUMMER`                                                      |
| `sma_test_con.csv`    | `SMATestCon` | One-line connectivity probe; any non-empty body counts as success.                                              |
